title: On Skating across the pond three times
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：skate　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 skate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the postman ① skated across the pond three times before dawn, and every sender in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the postman ② skates across the pond three times in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ skate across the pond three times at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ skated across the pond three times before — a line in the list for June 1978 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Skating across the pond three times before dawn, the postman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ skate past the reeds in one stride in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Skate past the reeds in one stride at once and never mention it again.

By 1991 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new sender from the next office ⑧ skates past the reeds in one stride before dawn every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the box, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ skated across the pond three times again when nobody else would.

⑩ To skate across the pond three times, my mother said in 1996, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody skates across the pond three times in public again and somebody must skate across the pond three times before dawn all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。

B. v. 滑冰（一般现在 skates across the pond three times：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）

answers.why: skate 意为“滑冰”，1984 年邮差天没亮就滑冰横穿池塘滑了三个来回，那是邮局里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 skated。
skate 意为“滑冰”，自那以后邮差当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 skates。
skate 意为“滑冰”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯滑冰横穿池塘滑了三个来回”，此处为不定式 to skate across the pond three times。
skate 意为“滑冰”，收发清单里 六月 那行字说明早在 1991 年之前就有人滑冰过，故用过去完成时 had skated。
skate 意为“滑冰”，邮差说“滑冰横穿池塘滑了三个来回这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 skating across the pond three times 作主语。
skate 意为“溜过”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去溜过从芦苇旁一溜而过”，should ever 之后用原形 skate past the reeds in one stride。
skate 意为“溜过”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻溜过从芦苇旁一溜而过（skate past the reeds in one stride at once），以后再也不要提起。
skate 意为“滑冰”，新来的寄信人每个星期都照例溜过从芦苇旁一溜而过，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 skates。
skate 意为“滑冰”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就滑冰横穿池塘滑了三个来回，用一般过去式 skated 叙述。
skate 意为“滑冰”，结尾那句是母亲 1996 年的话：要滑冰横穿池塘滑了三个来回，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和邮局记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 skate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1984 the postman skated across the pond three times before dawn, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the postman skates across the pond three times in public whenever the office asks.
Skating across the pond three times before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever skate past the reeds in one stride in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new sender from the next office skates past the reeds in one stride before dawn every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother skated across the pond three times again, and the office remembered that half.
